parsed.lower_bound_mechanism: inductive large-prime erasure preserving small-prime support
parsed.upper_bound_mechanism: global membership invariance modulo the primorial and residue counting
parsed.notes: Complete and correct. The scan characterization is proved using unboundedness and greediness; the erasure lemma handles every term by induction; membership then depends only on primes at most a_1. Translation invariance holds from a_1 onward, and counting terms in one length-L window yields the identity for every n.
